title: Atlas Launcher 1.7.2
summary: Convert character gold into Atlas credits and use them to change your name.

sections.title: Gold conversion
items: 100 gold grants €1 in Atlas credits. Remaining silver and copper stay on the character.
Conversion is final. Keep every character on the account logged out while it is processed.
A receipt confirms the conversion. Recover its result after refreshing or signing back in without spending the gold twice.

sections.title: Name change
items: Buy a name change for €7 in Atlas credits.
Choose the character and its new name through the native service in game.
